title: Simulation & Research Platform — implementation
summary: Transform the project into a serious policy experimentation platform: Monte Carlo simulation, sensitivity analysis, policy comparison, benchmarking, reproducible research exports, an authenticated API and dataset versioning. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: Monte Carlo and sensitivity analyses run over the engine and report results
Two or more saved models can be compared/benchmarked side by side
Research exports are reproducible and record engine/dataset/seed versions
A documented API exposes core capabilities under authentication
notes:
Scope (in): Monte Carlo simulation; Sensitivity analysis; Policy comparison; Model benchmarking; Research exports; API access; Dataset versioning
Out of scope: New socio-economic channels (EPIC-012); New distributional dimensions (EPIC-013)
